chunks: Observe the service of prayer from the sun's declining from the meridian to the darkening of the night, and the recitation at dawn. Indeed the Recitation at dawn is palpably evident.

key_terms.دُلُوكِ الشَّمْسِ: Decline of the sun (time for Dhuhr prayer)
key_terms.غَسَقِ اللَّيْلِ: Darkening of the night (time for Isha prayer)

ai.seo_question: What are the specific times for the five daily prayers mentioned in Surah Al-Isra?
ai.summary: This verse (17:78) establishes the temporal framework for the five daily prayers, anchoring them in the natural rhythm of creation from the sun's decline to the darkness of night. Shia scholars, such as Allamah Tabatabai, emphasize the phrase 'witnessed' (mashhoodan) to highlight the spiritual presence of angels and the divine observation during the dawn prayer, marking it as a pivotal moment of spiritual clarity. The verse serves as a foundational text for understanding the continuity of worship throughout the day and night.
